S.FORM: tee=ku t<um>a-tuuturu kamua makaasi-ini sua iiku ia, ni-r<um>aʔisi ʔikua vənai.
S.PHON: teeku tumatuuturu kamua makaaʂiini sua iiku ia nirumaʔiʂi ʔikua vənai
S.FORM: teeku t<um>atuuturu kamua makaasiini sua iiku ia, nir<um>a'isi 'ikua venai.
S.PHON: teeku tumatuutu[r|ɾ]u kamua makaaʂiini sua iiku ia ni[r|ɾ]umaʔiʂi ʔikua venai
S.TRANSL: Now I'll tell you about a snake biting me.

S.FORM: c<in>əʔəra=kiai ramuc=aku. ʔaisi=pa m-uru-vaa-vaakə.
S.PHON: tʂinəʔərakiai ramuʦaku ʔaiʂipa muruvaavaakə
S.FORM: c<in>e'erakiai ramucaku. 'aisipa muruvaavaake.
S.PHON: tʂineʔe[r|ɾ]akiai [r|ɾ]amuʦaku ʔaiʂipa mu[r|ɾ]uvaavaake
S.TRANSL: They looked at my hand. It was still swollen.

S.FORM: a-paica-u=pa naisi pu-kari-kari misai. tia=maku puu-kari-kari-an a-paica naisi.
S.PHON: apaiʦaupa naiʂi pukarikari misai tiamaku puukarikarian apaiʦa naiʂi
S.FORM: apaicaupa naisi pukarikari misai. tiamaku puukarikarian apaica naisi.
S.PHON: apaiʦaupa naiʂi puka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i misai tiamaku puuka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]ian apaiʦa naiʂi
S.TRANSL: This incident will be described verbally here.

S.FORM: sua ramuc=aku niŋai vaəsə ia, mia-iisua ia, tia=ku t<um>a-tuuturu ni-ala-anal-an-ni.
S.PHON: sua ramuʦaku niŋai vaəsə ia miaiisua ia tiaku tumatuuturu niaɾaanaɾanni
S.FORM: sua ramucaku ningai vaese ia, miaiisua ia, tiaku t<um>atuuturu niaraanaranni.
S.PHON: sua [r|ɾ]amuʦaku niŋai vaese ia miaiisua ia tiaku tumatuutu[r|ɾ]u nia[r|ɾ]aana[r|ɾ]anni
S.TRANSL: My hand being bitten by a snake, I'll tell how it happened at that time.

S.FORM: taniaara miaa-iisua ia, ni-musa=aku siipaar-a. mia mati-ʔulu=ku putu-kia-kiau ia, ni-ka-maanəŋ=ku təətan.
S.PHON: taniaara miaaiisua ia nimusaaku ʂiipaara mia matiʔuɾuku putukiakiau ia nikamaanəŋku təətan
S.FORM: taniaara miaaiisua ia, nimusaaku siipaara. mia mati'uruku putukiakiau ia, nikamaanengku teetan.
S.PHON: taniaa[r|ɾ]a miaaiisua ia nimusaaku ʂiipaa[r|ɾ]a mia matiʔu[r|ɾ]uku putukiakiau ia nikamaaneŋku teetan
S.TRANSL: On that day, I went over to the other side (of the river). I was to fix the water pipe first.

S.FORM: cani taniaara namasə m-i-ʔaranasə=ku mia-isua. ʔakia canumu, ʔakia si-pu-ʔucipi mia uuru.
S.PHON: ʦani taniaara namasə miʔaranasəku miaisua ʔakia ʦanumu ʔakia ʂipuʔutʂipi mia uuru
S.FORM: cani taniaara namase mi'aranaseku miaisua. 'akia canumu, 'akia sipu'ucipi mia uuru.
S.PHON: ʦani taniaa[r|ɾ]a namase miʔa[r|ɾ]anaseku miaisua ʔakia ʦanumu ʔakia ʂipuʔutʂipi mia uu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: It took me half a day to fix it. (We) could not cook rice without water.

S.FORM: mata-vəcəkai taniarə, ala-vali=ku pu-canum savuana.
S.PHON: matavəʦəkai taniarə aɾavaɾiku puʦanum savuana
S.FORM: matavecekai taniare, aravariku pucanum savuana.
S.PHON: mataveʦekai tania[r|ɾ]e a[r|ɾ]ava[r|ɾ]iku puʦanum savuana
S.TRANSL: At noon I went to spray (an area) with insecticide.

S.FORM: "sua na=mu-liuŋ tarikuuka=maku ia, rəmər-a=cu pu-canum-au=pa," misai. miciko=maku "pu-canum-ai ʔikua savuana."
S.PHON: sua namuɾiuŋ tarikuukamaku ia rəməraʦu puʦanumaupa misai mitʂikomaku puʦanumai ʔikua savuana
S.FORM: "sua namuriung tarikuukamaku ia, remeracu pucanumaupa," misai. micikomaku "pucanumai 'ikua savuana."
S.PHON: sua namu[r|ɾ]iuŋ ta[r|ɾ]ikuukamaku ia [r|ɾ]eme[r|ɾ]aʦu puʦanumaupa misai mitʂikomaku puʦanumai ʔikua savuana
S.TRANSL: "There was a bush around the chicken coop, spray an area with insecticide for me," my (wife) Michiko said.

S.FORM: pu-rupaŋ-ai ʔikua ʔuuna=ku tia=ta-u-kusa-a ʔacu=ku mii-ru-aimi mia-isua si kaʔan=ci=kia taavalaʔə pa-cəpə-cəpəŋ.
S.PHON: purupaŋai ʔikua ʔuunaku tiataukusaa ʔaʦuku miiruaimi miaisua ʂi kaʔantʂikia taavaɾaʔə paʦəpəʦəpəŋ
S.FORM: purupangai 'ikua 'uunaku tiataukusaa 'acuku miiruaimi miaisua si ka'ancikia taavara'e pacepecepeng.
S.PHON: pu[r|ɾ]upaŋai ʔikua ʔuunaku tiataukusaa ʔaʦuku mii[r|ɾ]uaimi miaisua ʂi kaʔantʂikia taava[r|ɾ]aʔe paʦepeʦepeŋ
S.TRANSL: When I finished the job, I forgot to go and do something else because it didn't occur to me then.

S.FORM: mu-caanə=ku mia-isua ia, ma-naasə mata-vəcəkai taniarə mia-iisua mu-caanə=ku mu-laucu.
S.PHON: muʦaanəku miaisua ia manaasə matavəʦəkai taniarə miaiisua muʦaanəku muɾauʦu
S.FORM: mucaaneku miaisua ia, manaase matavecekai taniare miaiisua mucaaneku muraucu.
S.PHON: muʦaaneku miaisua ia manaase mataveʦekai tania[r|ɾ]e miaiisua muʦaaneku mu[r|ɾ]auʦu
S.TRANSL: At noon time I walked down (the mountain).

S.FORM: mia-isua ia, naatia=ku mu-a-siparə na kompon. naatia=ku ara-siiparə ʔinia, ma-kaasi na mia-cara vutukulu si naatia=maku cəʔəra-ən ʔaisi=kara=ʔai ʔinia misa=kia.
S.PHON: miaisua ia naatiaku muaʂiparə na kompon naatiaku araʂiiparə ʔinia makaaʂi na miaʦara vutukuɾu ʂi naatiamaku ʦəʔəraən ʔaiʂikaraʔai ʔinia misakia
S.FORM: miaisua ia, naatiaku muasipare na kompon. naatiaku arasiipare 'inia, makaasi na miacara vutukuru si naatiamaku ce'eraen 'aisikara'ai 'inia misakia.
S.PHON: miaisua ia naatiaku muaʂipa[r|ɾ]e na kompon naatiaku a[r|ɾ]aʂiipa[r|ɾ]e ʔinia makaaʂi na miaʦa[r|ɾ]a vutuku[r|ɾ]u ʂi naatiamaku ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aen ʔaiʂika[r|ɾ]aʔai ʔinia misakia
S.TRANSL: I was about to cross (the stream) at Kompon because I was going to see if someone was guarding the fish (pond).

S.FORM: apanaapa nu maica=ku ʔinia ia, ʔakia. ʔakia ʔinia caau mia-isua.
S.PHON: apanaapa nu maiʦaku ʔinia ia ʔakia ʔakia ʔinia ʦaau miaisua
S.FORM: apanaapa nu maicaku 'inia ia, 'akia. 'akia 'inia caau miaisua.
S.PHON: apanaapa nu maiʦaku ʔinia ia ʔakia ʔakia ʔinia ʦaau miaisua
S.TRANSL: Sometimes when I got there, there was none. No one was there at that time.

S.FORM: paira maamia ni-pi-ʔinəv-a sua si-ʔinəv-a, tee=cu=ku m-əsə-tacəmə nuŋunuŋu.
S.PHON: paira maamia nipiʔinəva sua ʂiʔinəva teeʦuku məsətaʦəmə nuŋunuŋu
S.FORM: paira maamia nipi'ineva sua si'ineva, teecuku mesetaceme nungunungu.
S.PHON: pai[r|ɾ]a maamia nipiʔineva sua ʂiʔineva teeʦuku mesetaʦeme nuŋunuŋu
S.TRANSL: I closed the gate and I was going to jump down into the stream.

S.FORM: ʔuuna caənə tinəkəpə sua caənə. pati-saaʔ-ai ʔikua na tiʔusuʔusu makai tee=cu m-əsə-tacəmə nuŋunuŋu.
S.PHON: ʔuuna ʦaənə tinəkəpə sua ʦaənə patisaaʔai ʔikua na tiʔusuʔusu makai teeʦu məsətaʦəmə nuŋunuŋu
S.FORM: 'uuna caene tinekepe sua caene. patisaa'ai 'ikua na ti'usu'usu makai teecu mesetaceme nungunungu.
S.PHON: ʔuuna ʦaene tinekepe sua ʦaene patisaaʔai ʔikua na tiʔusuʔusu makai teeʦu mesetaʦeme nuŋunuŋu
S.TRANSL: There was a tuft of grass, and I seized it and released it before I jumped down into the stream.

S.FORM: makai c<in>akəp-a sua ramuc=aku. cəʔəra-i ʔikua ramuc=aku. ʔaisi=cu m-usu-caraʔə.
S.PHON: makai tʂinakəpa sua ramuʦaku ʦəʔərai ʔikua ramuʦaku ʔaiʂiʦu musuʦaraʔə
S.FORM: makai c<in>akepa sua ramucaku. ce'erai 'ikua ramucaku. 'aisicu musucara'e.
S.PHON: makai tʂinakepa sua [r|ɾ]amuʦaku ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]ai ʔikua [r|ɾ]amuʦaku ʔaiʂiʦu musuʦa[r|ɾ]aʔe
S.TRANSL: My hand seemed to be stung by something. I looked at it, and it was bleeding.

S.FORM: tara-ŋə-ŋəcai=ku c<um>əʔəra, "ucuucu ma-naanu?" misa=ku.
S.PHON: taraŋəŋəʦaiku ʦuməʔəra uʦuuʦu manaanu misaku
S.FORM: tarangengecaiku c<um>e'era, "ucuucu manaanu?" misaku.
S.PHON: ta[r|ɾ]aŋeŋeʦaiku ʦumeʔe[r|ɾ]a uʦuuʦu manaanu misaku
S.TRANSL: I looked up. "What kind of wasp is it?" I said.

S.FORM: kuu=ku c<um>əʔəra kulai ma-naanu, t<in-m>mana=ku maamia kaa-tai-taiʔisi ʔəna-ʔəna-i.
S.PHON: kuuku ʦuməʔəra kuɾai manaanu tinmmanaku maamia kaataitaiʔiʂi ʔənaʔənai
S.FORM: kuuku c<um>e'era kurai manaanu, t<inm>manaku maamia kaataitai'isi 'ena'enai.
S.PHON: kuuku ʦumeʔe[r|ɾ]a ku[r|ɾ]ai manaanu tinmmanaku maamia kaataitaiʔiʂi ʔenaʔenai
S.TRANSL: I could not see any snake or anything, but I could hear rustling sounds for quite a while.

S.FORM: ʔacu=kia maamia m-ara-nupunupu si ʔaisi=cu=maku cəʔəra-ən ramuc=aku.
S.PHON: ʔaʦukia maamia maranupunupu ʂi ʔaiʂiʦumaku ʦəʔəraən ramuʦaku
S.FORM: 'acukia maamia maranupunupu si 'aisicumaku ce'eraen ramucaku.
S.PHON: ʔaʦukia maamia ma[r|ɾ]anupunupu ʂi ʔaiʂiʦumaku ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aen [r|ɾ]amuʦaku
S.TRANSL: I was at a loss (what to do), and I just looked at my hand.

S.FORM: ʔaisi=cu m-uru-vaakə siki-səʔə-səʔələ sua nimuruʔ-in.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂiʦu muruvaakə ʂikisəʔəsəʔəɾə sua nimuruʔin
S.FORM: 'aisicu muruvaake sikise'ese'ere sua nimuru'in.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂiʦu mu[r|ɾ]uvaake ʂikiseʔeseʔe[r|ɾ]e sua nimu[r|ɾ]uʔin
S.TRANSL: It swelled up and blood was dripping out of my hand.

S.FORM: makasua=cu kaʔan=cu=ku taavalaʔə. kaʔan=cu=ku tara-kəna makai=ci=kia ni-ma-nava. maamia mala-liva-livaʔə.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu kaʔanʦuku taavaɾaʔə kaʔanʦuku tarakəna makaitʂikia nimanava maamia maɾaɾivaɾivaʔə
S.FORM: makasuacu ka'ancuku taavara'e. ka'ancuku tarakena makaicikia nimanava. maamia mararivariva'e.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu kaʔanʦuku taava[r|ɾ]aʔe kaʔanʦuku ta[r|ɾ]akena makaitʂikia nimanava maamia ma[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]iva[r|ɾ]ivaʔe
S.TRANSL: I didn't know it then. I couldn't see well as if I were drunk. I was making mistakes.

S.FORM: ni-avici=cu=maku kaa-vaŋvaŋ vanəkavuka=maku mu-siparə, ara-siiparə na tulikoŋ.
S.PHON: niavitʂiʦumaku kaavaŋvaŋ vanəkavukamaku muʂiparə araʂiiparə na tuɾikoŋ
S.FORM: niavicicumaku kaavangvang vanekavukamaku musipare, arasiipare na turikong.
S.PHON: niavitʂiʦumaku kaavaŋvaŋ vanekavukamaku muʂipa[r|ɾ]e a[r|ɾ]aʂiipa[r|ɾ]e na tu[r|ɾ]ikoŋ
S.TRANSL: I wore my trousers and went across (the stream) to Tulikong.

S.FORM: cəpəŋ=aku mia-sua ia, "ʔuuna-a=ʔai ʔeesi ʔinia mia-cara vutukulu," misa=ku.
S.PHON: ʦəpəŋaku miasua ia ʔuunaaʔai ʔeeʂi ʔinia miaʦara vutukuɾu misaku
S.FORM: cepengaku miasua ia, "'uunaa'ai 'eesi 'inia miacara vutukuru," misaku.
S.PHON: ʦepeŋaku miasua ia ʔuunaaʔai ʔeeʂi ʔinia miaʦa[r|ɾ]a vutuku[r|ɾ]u misaku
S.TRANSL: I thought at that time, "Perhaps someone was guarding the fish (pond) there."

S.FORM: naatia=ku a-p-aʔuun ʔinia ʔu-rupaca taanaasa mu-caaca. ma-kaasi na pouli=maku.
S.PHON: naatiaku apaʔuun ʔinia ʔurupaʦa taanaasa muʦaaʦa makaaʂi na pouɾimaku
S.FORM: naatiaku apa'uun 'inia 'urupaca taanaasa mucaaca. makaasi na pourimaku.
S.PHON: naatiaku apaʔuun ʔinia ʔu[r|ɾ]upaʦa taanaasa muʦaaʦa makaaʂi na pou[r|ɾ]imaku
S.TRANSL: I was to use a truck to carry me there to my (son) Pouli.

S.FORM: ma-kaasi=ku ʔinia ʔakia cau-ini. mu-caan=cu=ku ʔaisi=cu=maku ni-pati-saʔə maamia ramuc=aku.
S.PHON: makaaʂiku ʔinia ʔakia ʦauini muʦaanʦuku ʔaiʂiʦumaku nipatisaʔə maamia ramuʦaku
S.FORM: makaasiku 'inia 'akia cauini. mucaancuku 'aisicumaku nipatisa'e maamia ramucaku.
S.PHON: makaaʂiku ʔinia ʔakia ʦauini muʦaanʦuku ʔaiʂiʦumaku nipatisaʔe maamia [r|ɾ]amuʦaku
S.TRANSL: When I got there, no one was there. I left holding my own hand.

S.FORM: ʔaisi=ci=kia maamia s<um>a-pikipiki. ma-kasii=ku na pouli=maku.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂitʂikia maamia sumapikipiki makaʂiiku na pouɾimaku
S.FORM: 'aisicikia maamia s<um>apikipiki. makasiiku na pourimaku.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂitʂikia maamia sumapikipiki makaʂiiku na pou[r|ɾ]imaku
S.TRANSL: It's me who could only put on a long face. I went to my (son) Pouli.

S.FORM: makasua sua ma-manəŋ=pa, ʔaisi ʔinia k<um>a-kaən mata-vəcəkai taniarə.
S.PHON: makasua sua mamanəŋpa ʔaiʂi ʔinia kumakaən matavəʦəkai taniarə
S.FORM: makasua sua mamanengpa, 'aisi 'inia k<um>akaen matavecekai taniare.
S.PHON: makasua sua mamaneŋpa ʔaiʂi ʔinia kumakaen mataveʦekai tania[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: Then fortunately, he was there eating (lunch) at noon.

S.FORM: "pati-puli-au=pa kaən-an=su si tee=ci maa-kai-naanu cuuma niŋaai vaəsə," kisa-ən=naku
S.PHON: patipuɾiaupa kaənansu ʂi teetʂi maakainaanu ʦuuma niŋaai vaəsə kisaənnaku
S.FORM: "patipuriaupa kaenansu si teeci maakainaanu cuuma ningaai vaese," kisaennaku
S.PHON: patipu[r|ɾ]iaupa kaenansu ʂi teetʂi maakainaanu ʦuuma niŋaai vaese kisaennaku
S.TRANSL: "Put down your food because your father was bitten by a snake and (you) should do something about it," I said.

S.FORM: pati-puli-ai-in ʔinia kaən-ai-in, um-ava ʔikua um-avici naŋisalə ʔakia ʔinia kaa-savu-savuana.
S.PHON: patipuɾiaiin ʔinia kaənaiin umava ʔikua umavitʂi naŋisaɾə ʔakia ʔinia kaasavusavuana
S.FORM: patipuriaiin 'inia kaenaiin, umava 'ikua umavici nangisare 'akia 'inia kaasavusavuana.
S.PHON: patipu[r|ɾ]iaiin ʔinia kaenaiin umava ʔikua umavitʂi naŋisa[r|ɾ]e ʔakia ʔinia kaasavusavuana
S.TRANSL: He put down his food and took me to Nangisale, but no one was there at the

S.FORM: ma-kaasi naŋisalə, ʔakia cau-ini.
S.PHON: makaaʂi naŋisaɾə ʔakia ʦauini
S.FORM: makaasi nangisare, 'akia cauini.
S.PHON: makaaʂi naŋisa[r|ɾ]e ʔakia ʦauini
S.TRANSL: When (we) went to Nangisale, no one was there.

S.FORM: takə-səələ=ci=kimi maamia naŋisaalə, tee=kiri-kirimi maamia natia ma-ava ʔikua, ʔakia.
S.PHON: takəsəəɾətʂikimi maamia naŋisaaɾə teekirikirimi maamia natia maava ʔikua ʔakia
S.FORM: takeseerecikimi maamia nangisaare, teekirikirimi maamia natia maava 'ikua, 'akia.
S.PHON: takesee[r|ɾ]etʂikimi maamia naŋisaa[r|ɾ]e teeki[r|ɾ]iki[r|ɾ]imi maamia natia maava ʔikua ʔakia
S.TRANSL: We could only keep looking around Nangisale to find someone to take me (to a hospital,) but no one was around.

S.FORM: ʔətəa-n-ai kimia sua ma-aʔun caau nu məskaəm-in.
S.PHON: ʔətəanai kimia sua maaʔun ʦaau nu məskaəmin
S.FORM: 'eteanai kimia sua maa'un caau nu meskaemin.
S.PHON: ʔeteanai kimia sua maaʔun ʦaau nu meskaemin
S.TRANSL: We had to find a car.

S.FORM: um-ava=cu ʔikua ma-kaasi kizan. ʔaisi=cu=ku maamia t<um>a-taŋi, "tee=kia=kusa maa-kai-naanu?" misa=ku maamia.
S.PHON: umavaʦu ʔikua makaaʂi ki*an ʔaiʂiʦuku maamia tumataŋi teekiakusa maakainaanu misaku maamia
S.FORM: umavacu 'ikua makaasi kizan. 'aisicuku maamia t<um>atangi, "teekiakusa maakainaanu?" misaku maamia.
S.PHON: umavaʦu ʔikua makaaʂi ki*an ʔaiʂiʦuku maamia tumataŋi teekiakusa maakainaanu misaku maamia
S.TRANSL: He took me to Kizan. I was just crying and asked, "What shall I do?"

S.FORM: pati-saaʔ-ai ʔinia ʔaniʔacaŋ=maku, "apee, apee," misai "ʔakun t<um>aŋi," misai.
S.PHON: patisaaʔai ʔinia ʔaniʔaʦaŋmaku apee apee misai ʔakun tumaŋi misai
S.FORM: patisaa'ai 'inia 'ani'acangmaku, "apee, apee," misai "'akun t<um>angi," misai.
S.PHON: patisaaʔai ʔinia ʔaniʔaʦaŋmaku apee apee misai ʔakun tumaŋi misai
S.TRANSL: Someone patted my shoulder and said, "Uncle, Uncle, don't cry!"

S.FORM: kaʔan=kia taavalaʔə s<um>pin. kan ma-rainu=kia nakai kaʔan=kia tavalaʔə s<um>pin.
